top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye is a bounded, independently reproduced achievement: magic-wavelength trapping removes light-shift and motional errors for many neutral atoms at once, giving 10^-18 uncertainties. The two-name allocation is clean, and the citation can be scoped to neutral-atom lattice trapping so it stays distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes. It is preferable to no award.
